Search range in degrees (±). Coarse search runs in 1° steps then refines.
Apply rotation only when detected skew exceeds this (degrees).
Fine-search angle step in degrees.

0 = white border. >1 = k-means cluster count for background colour detection.
Padding around each detected text bbox before cropping.
Max child crops per page (1 = single page, 2 = two-page spread, 0 = no cap).
Minimum DPI scale-factor delta to trigger a resize.
ROI margin (≤ margin_mm) propagated downstream for Binarizer masking.

ROI shape: on = convex hull of the page's text boxes (dilated by roi_margin_mm), off = axis-aligned bounding rect. The hull is tighter on a slanted / perspective capture, where a rect swallows the corners — and with them the fingers holding the book.
Downsample to this DPI for detection; full-res used for cropping. Empty = no downscale.
Column-merge score cutoff for combining horizontally-overlapping boxes.
Weight of the inter-box gap term in the merge score.
Weight of the width-similarity term in the merge score.
Cap on the normalized inter-box gap used in the merge score.
Text detector backend. auto = dbnet → apple_vision (macOS) → east. No heuristic fallback.

Reject layouts whose (p95−p5) range UNDER THEIR DETECTION BOXES is below this fraction of the max across all merged layouts in the scan. Polarity-agnostic. Measured under the boxes, not over the layout bbox, which is a density proxy that deleted sparse real pages. Legitimate text > 0.7; bleed-through < 0.5. 0 = disabled.
Binarization algorithm (doxapy: wolf++/wolf/sauvola/niblack/nick/… plus otsu). gray keeps grayscale; none passes through.
Wolf-family window in mm. Each doxa family has its own window_mm_<family> / window_px_<family> / k_<family> (e.g. window_mm_sauvola, k_sauvola).
Wolf-family threshold bias. Higher = whiter. Per-family k_<family> exists for each algorithm.
If meta.roi is set, erode the mask N iterations before applying.
Morphological close (0–10) after thresholding.
Where to source text-line bboxes from.
Below this many detected lines, fall back to passthrough.
Horizontal MORPH_CLOSE kernel for line bridging (mm at page DPI). Fallback when <30 char-like CCs available.
Adaptive MORPH_CLOSE kernel width = mult × median char height. Bridges words into full-line spans.
TEXT_MAX_THICKNESS = mult × median char height (≈ ascender + x-height + descender). Drops multi-line bridged blobs.
EDGE_MAX_LENGTH = mult × median char height. Max Euclidean gap between adjacent cinfos the span-builder will link. 3 ≈ one wide justified word gap + margin.
RANSAC trials for the column-edge fits (per-side) and the horizontal VP fit.
RANSAC inlier tolerance for the VP fit (degrees).
Extra padding around the rectified column quad.
Remap interpolation mode. auto = nearest on BW inputs, cubic otherwise.
Reject if column-quad covers less of the crop than this.
Skip Zhang-He metric upgrade when quad is nearly axis-aligned.
Reject ZH aspect if it drifts more than this fraction from bbox aspect.
Reject if median baseline tilt exceeds this.
Sanity cap on recovered w/h.
Save VP/line overlay as debug image to meta.
Surface the 'Normalize character width' checkbox in the GUI (pre-ticked).

Page edge carrying the binding. auto reads the PageDetector page_side meta (left page of a spread → binding right, and vice versa); set explicitly for single-page scans. Unresolved auto turns the spine-zone weighting and spine-curl search off for that page.

Optimizer backend. auto = LM (cylindrical) or MLX → padded JAX → Powell (spline models). lm = Levenberg-Marquardt with analytic Jacobians and Schur/arrowhead sparsity — CPU, ~70× faster than Powell, cylindrical only. WARNING: jax has unresolved issue on Apple hardware (memory cache fills up); prefer MLX.

LM only: fit the camera principal point (cx, cy) as well as the pose. Absorbs the projective camera that a keystone homography composed with a curled page produces — measured −57% output line curvature after TrapezoidalCorrection.

LM only: residual weight AT the binding, ramping to 1 at the edge of the spine zone. The spine tail is a least-squares minority, so an unweighted fit under-curls there. 1 = off (also off when the binding side is unknown).
LM only: width of the up-weighted spine zone as a fraction of the keypoint x-range.

LM only: comma-separated γ grid for the spine-localized curl term z += γ·exp(−|x−x_bind|/s). Each value is fitted and the best objective wins (γ = 0, the plain cubic, is always a candidate). Needs principal_point to be identifiable. Empty disables the search.
LM only: decay length s of the spine curl term, as a fraction of the model page width.
Reject the dewarp if remap goes more than this many pixels out of bounds.
Minimum span count to run the cubic fit. Below this, the fit is under-constrained and passthrough is safer. 3 since the LM solver replaced Powell — it recovers a sheet from far fewer baselines.
Drop spans whose width is less than this fraction of the widest span in the scan. 0 = disabled.
Which fitted text-line curve(s) constrain the sheet: bottom = baselines, top = x-height toplines, average = midlines, both = baseline + topline as separate spans (doubles vertical constraints).
Robust pseudo-Huber reprojection loss — caps the pull of stray spans (footers, captions). Off = plain L2.
Pseudo-Huber transition scale (normalized units).
Mask margin in mm — defines the page-extent rectangle for span detection.
Pre-dewarp white padding around the crop (mm).
Decimation factor for the remap grid. Lower = sharper but slower.
Penalty on rvec[0]² (camera tilt).
L2 penalty on cubic slopes α, β. 0 = no penalty.
Normalized camera focal length. Overridden by calibration if present.
Horizontal MORPH_CLOSE kernel fallback (mm at analysis DPI). Used when <30 char-like CCs available.
Adaptive MORPH_CLOSE kernel width = mult × median char height. Bridges words into full-line spans.
Drop connected components whose bounding-box area exceeds (mult × median char height)² before span detection — removes table-grid lines. Use 0 to disable.
TEXT_MAX_THICKNESS = mult × median char height (3× ≈ ascender + x-height + descender + margin).
EDGE_MAX_LENGTH = mult × median char height. Max gap between atoms the span-builder will link.
Downsample to this DPI for span analysis; full-res for the remap.
Surface the 'Normalize character width' checkbox in the GUI (pre-ticked).
CSS-style margin in mm. "10" all sides; "10 20" V H; "10 20 30 40" L R T B.
Same as margin_mm but in pixels (overrides margin_mm when set).
